available_varieties: sultana and other Iranian raisin varieties
qualification_requirements: Verify legal entity and official website
Verify public business contact from official source
Confirm acceptance of Iran origin and lawful payment/shipping route
Confirm variety, grade, moisture, size, color, defects and food-safety specifications
Confirm volume, packaging, destination port and Incoterms
Record evidence URL and date for every material claim
data_quality_rules: Never invent buyer names, contacts, prices, shipment records or certifications
Distinguish verified facts from estimates and hypotheses
Treat trade-database snippets as leads, not proof of current purchasing intent
Do not store sensitive personal contact data unless lawfully sourced and necessary
